drafts.walkScript: In lines 13 and 14 he returns a cardigan whose owner has left. Yet on line 33 his own jumper goes in "the Friday box". On line 47 he says "It won't fit me next year." On line 48 Miss Bhatt looks "longer than the answer needed", so size is not everything. He is giving up next year, so the trials sheet has a space he won't fill.
